reasons: Cited text supports the compliant status: 22.1 caps audits at once per twelve-month period, requires thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, and an independent auditor bound by confidentiality — matching every element of the preferred position.

22.2 allocates audit costs to Vendor unless underpayment exceeds five percent and expressly bars Vendor and its auditor from direct access to Customer systems, Customer Data unrelated to usage, privileged material, or third-party confidential information, so the walk-away triggers (unlimited/unannounced audits, remote system access) are absent.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the deterministic frequency check also passes.

Section 23 being a bare heading is consistent with the rationale that no broader inspection or access right exists in the supplied text; nothing in the provided paragraphs contradicts the compliance conclusion.
